args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Persist the user's chosen export format (e.g. in localStorage) and initialize the `format` state from it instead of always defaulting to the `defaultFormat`/"csv" prop, updating the stored value whenever the user changes the selection.

label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.
ExportButton.tsx defines `defaultFormat = "csv"` and initializes `useState<ExportFormat>(defaultFormat)` with no persistence mechanism, so the dropdown always resets to CSV on each page load, matching the reporter's complaint that the export format menu reverts to CSV every time.
